notes: Rule 6: the story speaks in the scene: Ali burns people, then Ibn Abbas says «لم أكن لأحرقهم» and quotes the Prophet, and Ali answers. The chain as written ends at Ikrima; whether Ibn Abbas is the last link (his words relay the saying) cannot be settled from the text, so no link is added and the ruling is set
«عليه السلام» and «رضي الله عنه» are left out
